sourceFinding: The usability check used ordinary 4096-byte context excerpts, then rejected the incomplete flag as an unusable answer. A complete longer reply can therefore block a fresh conversation before text entry.
correction: Inspect only the latest private pair using the existing 32768-byte per-message and bounded frame profile. No answer text is exported by this check. Actual load-error placeholders, missing answers and answers exceeding the bound remain refused.
nextAction: Repackage verified existing development executables with qualified primitives, then resume the same unchanged intent only after confirming no text-entry/submission checkpoint. Do not prepare a replacement intent or resend an unknown message.
